devUi.title: UI foundation
devUi.intro: Design tokens from docs/DESIGN.md, rendered in the current theme.
devUi.motionIntro: Tokens from docs/MOTION.md section 2. Components that use them appear below as they are built.

demos.reveal: Fades in and rises 12 px (24 px for headings) when 20% is visible, once.
demos.revealGroup: Staggers its children 80 ms apart (40 ms in lists, max 8 rows).
demos.hoverLift: Rises 4 px and gains the raised shadow on hover (CSS, 150 ms).
demos.sampleHeading: Your whole event team, on the same page.
demos.sampleBody: Tasks, budget, guests and schedule in one shared plan.
demos.countUp: Counts to the value when in view (800 ms), then from the old value on updates (400 ms). en-IN format.
demos.progressFill: Fills from 0 in 600 ms; turns green with a 150 ms fade when it reaches 100%.
demos.checkDraw: Box fills, then the tick draws (250 ms). Reduced motion: the tick fades in.
demos.liveHighlight: Indigo glow behind a changed row: 1.5 s for a teammate's change, 800 ms for your own.
